subject: HOF Gen6 visual security: unknown/stale provenance + incomplete pixel-lease fencing
body: Completed the non-production visual-security/provenance lane. Started at main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2; main advanced to child 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44 and all six audited blobs were revalidated byte-identical, so findings remain current. SOURCE: Gen6 V2 policy defaults blank/unknown foreground provenance to PUBLIC_GLASS; privacy runtime has no event-time/generation/attempt fence and package change clears capture denial, permitting stale/public callbacks to downgrade PRIVATE_FROST; SnapshotCache and Fold7ContinuityFrameStore leases do not bind user/profile/package/task/window/foreground-revision provenance; best-effort work-profile detection collapses query/reflection failure to false. These violate the existing contract's fail-closed unknown provenance, monotonic private attempt, stale-callback, and provenance-bound lease requirements. V2's secure-layer pre-materialization checks, secure-aware prime/live capture, procedural PRIVATE_FROST, generation invalidation and cache clears are preserved strengths. MODEL: deterministic reproductions PASS; 100,000 adversarial stale-callback/context-migration sequences yielded 100,000 current-model private-downgrade violations by construction and 0 proposed-model invariant violations; proposed model rejected all 100,000 stale callbacks and 100,000 mismatched old-context leases. FIELD COVERAGE: supplied field bundle has only 2 privacy events, both PUBLIC_GLASS; 0 PRIVATE_FROST, 0 secure-layer, 0 workProfile=true, 0 Coast Capital, 0 non-null captureDenied, so physical no-leak gate is untested. Recommend Manager mark security acceptance NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE/BLOCKED until fail-closed unknown, stale-event fence, attempt-local private monotonicity, tri-state profile uncertainty and provenance-bound pixel leases are implemented/tested. No hinge/panel/wallpaper/presentation/120Hz policy changes; no production Git writes.
